name: Mia
source:
A demi-human girl who was sold as a slave.
Relying on the memento photograph, she escaped to the protagonist's inn.
Thanks to her life at the inn, her fur became silky, chest became voluptuous, hipline became refined, and her butt, which sported a tail, became plump.
She became beautiful beyond recognition.
